company_blurb: Halcyon Metrics builds enterprise analytics software in Helsinki, helping mid-market teams track operational performance and forecast quarterly growth with clear, reliable dashboards.

departments.culture: Engineering values clean architecture, thorough code reviews, and uninterrupted focus blocks. Team members communicate asynchronously via tickets and prefer practical solutions over flashy tooling.

Finance operates on predictable monthly cycles, accuracy, and clear documentation. Meetings start on time, spreadsheets are versioned carefully, and forecasts are grounded in conservative assumptions.
Legal prioritizes clarity, risk mitigation, and structured review workflows. The team collaborates closely with other units to turn complex regulations into straightforward operational guidelines.
Sales is energetic, goal-oriented, and collaborative. Representatives celebrate closed renewals together, share notes from prospect calls, and rely heavily on clean operational data.

personas.bio: Kalle maintains core data pipelines and enjoys refactoring legacy backend services while drinking strong black coffee.
Petri builds revenue forecast models and enjoys spotting subtle seasonal trends in customer usage spreadsheets.
Pihla keeps the CRM tidy, automates territory routing, and loves organizing team trivia every Friday afternoon.
Hanna oversees regulatory filings and vendor audits, ensuring internal policies stay aligned with European standards.
Eero manages accounts payable and monthly reconciliations with quiet precision and a strict adherence to deadlines.
Antti organizes contract archives, drafts standard addenda, and always remembers everyone's birthday in the office.
Elina manages key Nordic client relationships, guiding enterprise prospects through product demos and contract renewals.
Lauri reviews commercial agreements and advises leadership on licensing terms and corporate governance matters.
Tuomas leads quarterly quota planning, coaches account executives on pipeline health, and favors direct feedback.
Sanna coordinates commission reporting and onboarding materials, making sure new reps have everything they need.
Jussi supervises financial close processes, cash flow reporting, and departmental budget variance reviews.
Olli handles invoicing schedules and expense audits, keeping ledger entries accurate without unnecessary fuss.
